digest.component_or_area: rebar code-review framework - project criteria extension
propositions: Project code-review criteria declared in repository overlays were dropped at five seams: criterion-id resolver, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration admission, and CLI admission

Eight interdependent seam repairs across criterion resolution, batch-runner fan-in attribution, repository-effective Pass-3 routing, eval/calibration API, and CLI admission must execute in order to complete the extension contract
Project code-review criteria must execute once in Round A, retain logical criteria id and physical reviewer_id, and use repository-effective Pass-3 routing thresholds and blocking configuration
The eval/calibration API and CLI must distinguish active project code-review criteria from inactive or ambiguous project ids and admit only valid ones to the evaluation corpus
The project-criterion runtime contract and extension points must be documented and proven through end-to-end unit tests spanning the entire four-pass seam
A live Gerrit dogfood deployment must demonstrate advisory-only project criterion routing with zero directive conflicts and successful integrated review coverage
